title: snapcn Remotion components (21)
what_it_does: Text reveals, device frames, terminal, captions, logo stings and scenes as Remotion React components installed with the shadcn CLI.
when_to_use: Not usable: they are React plus Remotion, not HTML plus GSAP.
why: MIT but the wrong runtime for HyperFrames; porting each would be a rewrite. Take the registry design instead.
